summary.text: Dean Brewer of Knoxville, an independent who qualified by petition, filing on March 10, 2026, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Governor of Tennessee to Marsha Blackburn, with 0.2% of the vote to her 45.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

A May 2026 independent voter guide quoted him as saying, "It's time we remember how to be America and work together as Americans again," and reported that he described a program to house homeless veterans and provide counseling and on-the-job trade training. No occupation or other biographical detail could be sourced.
